description: Create real downloadable PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, Markdown, text or JSON. Reports need format, name and content; missing format extensions are appended. For verified table-query output, supply tableObservationId (the query's observationId) instead of copying columns/rows: the owner transfers exact checked data into the file. Otherwise supply columns and structured rows, with numeric JSON values for numeric cells. XLSX/CSV also need totalColumns: indexes to sum, or [] for no total/mixed currencies. Supply detail rows only; requested Decimal totals are appended. verifiedPreview is read back from the file. Return the receipt URL; never recreate a successful file to restate the answer.
